say:2:1830155001:1.text: You bet! I've adored her for almost ten years and never miss a single one of her shows!
say:2:1830155001:1.source_cn: 可不是。我已经喜欢她快十年了，她的每一场演出我都会去！
say:2:1830155001:1.male: You bet! I've adored her for almost ten years and never miss a single one of her shows!
say:2:1830155001:1.female: You bet! I've adored her for almost ten years and never miss a single one of her shows!

say:3:1830155002:1.text: No one knew how hard I cried when Senea passed away a year ago! So once I heard she was going to perform in Novaris as a Graveborn, I immediately bought a ticket and came straight here!
say:3:1830155002:1.source_cn: 一年前她去世的时候，我的眼睛都快哭瞎了……没想到她居然...
say:3:1830155002:1.male: No one knew how hard I cried when Senea passed away a year ago! So once I heard she was going to perform in Novaris as a Graveborn, I immediately bought a ticket and came straight here!
say:3:1830155002:1.female: No one knew how hard I cried when Senea passed away a year ago! So once I heard she was going to perform in Novaris as a Graveborn, I immediately bought a ticket and came straight here!

say:4:1830155003:1.text: Not just us. Lots of fellow fans have come here just to see her perform again.
say:4:1830155003:1.source_cn: 不止我俩，好多剧迷也和我们一样来到诺珐斯，都是为了再见...
say:4:1830155003:1.male: Not just us. Lots of fellow fans have come here just to see her perform again.
say:4:1830155003:1.female: Not just us. Lots of fellow fans have come here just to see her perform again.

say:5:1830155004:1.text: Knowing she's still around, even as a Graveborn, is all we could ask for...
say:5:1830155004:1.source_cn: 只要确定她还存在，哪怕是变成了亡灵，我们也心满意足了……
say:5:1830155004:1.male: Knowing she's still around, even as a Graveborn, is all we could ask for...
say:5:1830155004:1.female: Knowing she's still around, even as a Graveborn, is all we could ask for...
